name: Drowse Touch
description: Brush two fingers over a foe's brow and send a heavy drowse that slows the foe's hands and thoughts.

name: Dream Recall
description: Touch a waking ally's temple and call up the dream the ally lost on waking so its meaning can be read.

name: Lull Hum
description: Hum a slow low tone that drags a tired foe toward sleep for as long as the tone lasts.

name: Pillow Veil
description: Spread a soft veil of dream force over the self that dulls a blow as if it fell on a pillow.

name: Waking Nudge
description: Jolt a drowsing ally awake with a bright pulse of dream force so the ally's mind clears at once.

name: Soft Slumber
description: Settle an exhausted ally into a deep light sleep that restores strength and calms the ache of strain.

name: Doze Mist
description: Breathe out a fine mist of dream force that makes the foes who breathe it yawn and falter.

name: Murmur Sense
description: Listen for the faint murmur of sleepers nearby and judge how many there are and how deeply each dreams.

name: Bassinet Ward
description: Rock the self in a cradle of dream force that turns aside a rush by letting the blow drift past.

name: Restful Breath
description: Guide an ally through slow breaths of dream force until the ally's body eases and a minor hurt fades.

name: Hazy Step
description: Step as if half asleep so the body blurs and a foe loses the exact place where the user stands.

name: Blinking Daze
description: Flash a quick dazing image into a foe's mind so the foe blinks and loses the thread of a strike.

name: Slow Drift
description: Slow a foe's movements as if the foe waded through the thick air of a dream.

name: Reverie Pull
description: Tug a foe's attention into a daydream for a heartbeat so the foe's guard drops open.

name: Idle Wander
description: Let a foe's thoughts wander aimlessly with a faint pressure of dream force until the foe forgets the target.

name: Wakeful Guard
description: Hold the mind sharply awake behind a wall of dream force so no drowsing power can slip in.

name: Reverie Mend
description: Lead an ally into a gentle reverie where the mind rests and light bruises ease.

name: Muse Sense
description: Open the mind to the idle thoughts of the people near and catch what they dwell on.

name: Fancy Spark
description: Strike a bright spark of fancy in an ally's mind that sharpens focus for a short while.

name: Dream Step
description: Slip half into the dream layer for one stride so the body shifts to a new place at once.

name: Walker's Glance
description: Glance into the dream layer from the waking world and see whether a sleeper's dream is calm or troubled.

name: Drift Screen
description: Raise a drifting screen of dream force that makes a strike slide past the user's real position.

name: Sleeper's Grip
description: Tangle a drowsing foe's limbs in a dream of heavy sleep so the foe cannot rise.

name: Quiet Mind
description: Still the racing mind of an ally with a calm dream until the ally's body rests and its strain fades.

name: Sudden Slack
description: Drain the tension from a foe's arms in one dream-soft breath so the weapon sags in the foe's grip.

name: Lucid Spark
description: Spark a moment of lucid clarity in an ally's mind so the ally sees through a confusion.

name: Thought Blur
description: Blur a foe's thoughts with a flicker of dream force so the foe's next move comes late.

name: Sleeper's Sense
description: Keep a light thread of dream force on a sleeper and feel at once if the dream turns to fear.

name: Gentle Nod
description: Make a foe's head nod forward with a soft push of dream force and cut the foe's focus.

name: Bedside Ward
description: Set a quiet ward of dream force over a sleeper so no hostile mind can step into the dream.

name: Calm Dreaming
description: Turn a restless sleeper's dream to a soft scene so the body mends easily in rest.

name: Rested Grant
description: Share the rest of a deep dream with a worn ally so the ally wakes with fresh strength.

name: Waking Dream
description: Lay a dream over a foe's open eyes so the foe sees a scene that is not there.

name: Daydream Lure
description: Dangle a pleasant daydream before a foe's mind so the foe's aim drifts off the user.

name: Clear Waking
description: Wash the fog of dream from a dazed ally's mind and return the ally to full waking sense.

name: Reality Check
description: Test the world around the user for the wrongness of a dream and learn if a scene is false.

name: Haze Guard
description: Cloak the self in a haze of dream force that muffles the force of an incoming strike.

name: Eased Mind
description: Ease a frightened ally's mind with a warm familiar dream until fear and exhaustion ebb away.

name: Floating Gait
description: Move with the weightless gait of a dream so each step covers more ground with less sound.
